parental-controls.answer: The stable parental-controls guide is the age-suitability entry point. Combine a Kids Profile, restricted server identity and household Parental PIN; Kids profiles disable external Discovery but do not add an app-wide maturity filter. The PIN protects restricted settings and leaving Kids profiles, unlike an individual Profile Lock. Library hiding is not account-wide access control and network shares have no server maturity filter. Kids playlist sources remain unavailable without a Parental PIN and explicit approval; approval is whole-source and device-local. Use a restricted Seerr user and check content and automatic sign-in on each device.

apple-tv-user-sign-in.answer: Select each Apple TV user, authorize the desired Plozz profile, then enable Settings > Profiles > Automatically Sign In. The shared roster and server sign-ins do not make active selection or the trusted startup session shared: those remain system-user-local and opt-in. Manual switches and changed trust still require authorization; this is not a name match or server-user creation. With automatic sign-in off, background browsing triggers profile selection on return immediately when any profile is locked or bound to a protected Plex user, otherwise after five minutes with multiple profiles; one unlocked profile does not trigger it. Video/music/live playback, external-player departure and inactive-only interruptions do not trigger this browsing return check.

combined-library-browsing.answer: All Libraries pages enabled non-music libraries across accounts on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad, preserving original-server ownership and merging matching identities where possible. More than one browsable library is required for its shortcut. All TV layouts support eligible shortcuts; mobile library shortcuts start hidden. In Screens & Navigation > App navigation > Hide or Reorder Navigation, hold All Libraries and choose Show, then open it from navigation or compact More. Individual mobile libraries can be shown there too; hiding shortcuts does not disable content. Choose an accessible copy through the title's server/version selector, in TV's header More actions when offered. Combined Home rows remain independent.

continue-watching-retention.answer: Continue Watching, including merged Next Up titles, defaults to an unbounded provider feed with no age cutoff. Separate Next Up rows are previews of up to 20 titles, not the complete feed. Account-wide Continue Watching and server Next Up are queried independently of disabled library/catalogue discovery switches. Provider results, watched/dismissal state, account inclusion and server-user authorization still apply; hiding a library is not access control. Include Next Up defaults on in Screens & Navigation > Home > Rows > Continue Watching, folding source-supplied next episodes into Continue Watching and hiding separate editor rows. Disable it to arrange those separately; removing Continue Watching suspends merging. The Rows editor retains Continue Watching settings while the row is hidden.

alphabet-navigation.answer: In an Apple TV name-sorted title browse, scroll a few rows down to reveal the indexed letter rail and focus a letter to jump. Collection members and other sorts do not qualify. Combined or Silo jumps load on demand; select the letter again after a failed jump, or change sort away and back to name to rebuild a failed index. Mobile now has a wired All Libraries destination, but its grid still has feedback/destination hooks without a constructed alphabet menu or rail entry point. Use mobile filters, scrolling or Search instead.

top-shelf.answer: Put Plozz in Apple TV's top Home Screen row. From an adult profile, Settings > Everyone > Top Shelf offers default-on Show Top Shelf, Posters (default) or Full Screen and independent 1-20 Continue Watching/Recently Added counts, defaulting to four each. Full Screen expands with tvOS swipe-up; Play requests playback while More Info opens details without autoplay. Poster selection requests playback. Preferences stay device-local across Plozz profiles; disabling clears media but retains choices. A saved, access-scoped Home snapshot is not live browsing; short feeds are not padded, same-source repeats deduplicate in Full Screen, and authorization/source failures remain visible. Artwork and full-screen spoilers respect profile policy.

community-skip-markers.answer: Enable Settings > Playback > Skip intros, credits & more, then open Customize. Default behavior offers Show skip button, Skip instantly or Skip after (1-30 seconds); Enable for controls movie/TV/anime eligibility. Each marker opens category-specific rules, including Off or Use default to restore the shared behavior. Disabled categories must first be enabled on the previous page. Actions need markers. With skipping enabled, Use community markers (default on) checks IntroDB/TheIntroDB when server intro or credits markers are missing, filling missing marker kinds without replacing server markers. Requests send movie/series IMDb, TMDB or TVDB IDs plus applicable episode coordinates, ordering, episode name and runtime, not video files. Matching and database availability limit coverage. Turning this off stops community requests, not server-provided markers.

dual-subtitles.answer: Select primary text, then another text track through Apple TV Style > Dual Subtitles (or its direct control) or mobile Subtitles > Advanced… > Second Track; Off there removes only the second line. Mobile portrait starts in the ellipsis Playback options menu, while landscape separates controls. Plozzigen can decode embedded second text tracks; native playback needs fetchable text delivery. Image primaries disable dual mode and images cannot be second tracks. Locally remuxed wireless AirPlay has no selectable subtitles.

library-channels.answer: Open Live TV Sources > Plozz channels; enable the automatic lineup or Create custom channel. Automatic channels are not individually editable; Retry Plozz channels recovers preparation errors and Refresh Plozz channels rebuilds prepared lineups. For custom channels choose accessible Plex/Jellyfin/Emby libraries, movies/episodes, order and rules, then Preview schedule and Save channel. Missing/invalid durations exclude titles; blank rules allow all matches. Changes start after published programs. Cross-device schedules need catalogue snapshots. Update watch history is profile-scoped, device-local and default-off; enabling it can mark programs watched after 90% actual viewing without resume writes. Both shells use the authorized completion mutation pipeline, so matching servers follow the cross-server history setting and connected video/anime trackers can receive eligible completions too. Playback uses original files, not IPTV or Silo sources.

offline-background.answer: On iPhone/iPad, select a movie/episode's server and version if offered before downloading; for a show use Manage Seasons to download available episodes or choose a season/episode. Choose quality, wait for completed status in Downloads and test that copy's video, audio and subtitles offline. Playback prefers a usable matching download even with another server/version selected; changing servers alone does not force streaming. Eligible HTTP transfers use background sessions; in-process/share transfers need foreground execution unless the OS grants continued processing. Switching profiles pauses that profile's transfers; return to the owning profile to resume. iOS/iPadOS 26 Live Activities can be declined; cancellation/expiry pauses active work without deleting partial files. All received bytes still require offline validation. Network, speed, source and storage limits remain; Apple TV has no downloads.

cross-server-history.answer: Sync across all my servers in Trackers (mobile also exposes Sync watch state across servers in Playback) defaults on and propagates watched-state/resume updates to matching accessible copies. Apple TV enables its control when multiple servers exist. Turning it off keeps writes scoped to the originating server. This is distinct from CloudKit configuration/profile sync and from scrobbling to third-party trackers; server identities and permissions still govern delivery.

version-selection.answer: Use the first-use Ask every time or Choose automatically choice and the title/player version controls where supported. Series-version memory is independent of prompt mode. Automatic mode can use a device recommendation when the remembered type is missing; it does not promise that every episode has the same file. On mobile, a usable matching download takes precedence over streaming even with another source/version selected; check the saved edition rather than assuming a source switch forces streaming.

device-setup.answer: Choose Set up from another device on the receiver and send from the configured device's iCloud Sync screen over the same local network, allowing Local Network access. Use nearby selection, code or QR; camera permission is needed for scanning. Compare codes when prompted; same-account rendezvous can authenticate without that comparison. Only supported credentials transfer. Mobile iCloud Keychain can separately adopt supported server/share/Seerr logins; Apple TV uses pairing or sign-in instead and Silo always needs its own device approval.

App/PlozziOS/Info.plist.summary: Local Network permission supports discovery/pairing; Camera is used for setup QR scanning with code entry as an alternative. Background audio, processing and download task identifiers support documented route- and OS-dependent behavior, not guaranteed execution. External-app query schemes support Infuse/VLC availability; the registered return URL is routed by the mobile root through validated external playback receipts into authorized viewer-owned watch mutations, not accepted as arbitrary progress.

App/PlozziOS/PlozziOS.branded.entitlemen.omitReason: Side-by-side development builds intentionally omit canonical cloud and associated-domain capabilities; these internal provisioning variants are not consumer setup features.

App/PlozziOS/PlozziOS.entitlements.summary: CloudKit/presence and pairing universal links are wired; supported mobile credentials use a separate synchronizable Keychain path rather than making all CloudKit server descriptors authenticated.

App/Resources/Info.plist.summary: The declared Guide-button activity is consumed by MainTabView only when Live TV is enabled, then opens the full-screen channel player's guide. Background audio uses the music controller and Now Playing session for screensaver listening and Control Center commands. External-app query schemes detect Native Player/Infuse/VLC; RootView routes the registered callback into nonce-, URL-, age- and authorization-validated receipts before AppState writes viewer-owned progress. External handoff is separate from AirPlay and Apple's in-app native engine.

App/Resources/Plozz.branded.entitlements.omitReason: Empty entitlements belong to internal side-by-side development builds; production Apple TV user management and Top Shelf use the canonical entitlements instead.

App/Resources/Plozz.entitlements.summary: Canonical Apple TV capabilities support shared sign-ins and profile storage with system-user-local selection and opt-in automatic sign-in. CloudKit/push declarations do not establish dependable background execution: the root's foreground transition explicitly fetches enabled cloud sync.

TopShelf/ContentProvider.swift.summary: The extension renders the shared saved snapshot as native poster sections or a details carousel. Full Screen has distinct Play/More Info routes; both resolve only within admitted active accounts. The adult settings entry controls default-on visibility, style and per-feed counts on this device without broadening source permissions.

TopShelf/TopShelf.branded.entitlements.omitReason: This development-only Top Shelf extension deliberately lacks the canonical app group; it does not add a user-facing control or alternative setup procedure.

connections.summary: Connect supported media servers, approved Silo devices, IPTV accounts or wired share transports; shared sign-ins differ from profile library selection/server-user access. Manual Jellyfin/Emby checks prefer HTTPS, with eligible HTTP alternatives but no downgrade after explicit HTTPS or TLS rejection. Choose later defers initial library selection without declaring failed discovery empty. Libraries > Watching as or mobile identity controls select existing users; adding another sign-in does not create server users. Sign In Again validates the original account/server/profile without deleting a connection on failure/cancellation. Manage only trusted verified alternate addresses; HTTP is unencrypted, Silo reapproves and Tailscale needs manual entry on an already-connected playback device. WebDAV folder browsing does not establish seekable playback: the network-share section explains valid byte ranges and strong ETag/valid Last-Modified requirements, administrator checks and rescan/reopen after replacing files.

library.summary: Browse, filter, sort and search enabled libraries; All Libraries now combines them on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad, with explicit mobile shortcut visibility explained in the combined-library capability. Only Apple TV exposes the name-sort letter rail. Genre/year intersect quick filters; preparation, interrupted collections and failed facets retain cancellation/retry paths. Collections, playlists, extras, IPTV on-demand catalogues and source/version selection remain distinct from requests and schedule-only placeholders. Watchlist covers save/removal, filters, date/name sorting, profile ownership and connected-list effects; disabling sources does not erase explicit saves. History actions distinguish watched-state changes from Continue Watching dismissal/resume clearing and cross-server delivery. Library tabs and Recommended rows differ from Home/main shortcuts; Browse is the fallback, shares lack Recommended, and collection-cover shapes have independent library/row scopes. Preserve reset scope and hidden-row recovery. Server-owned trailers/previews play in Plozz; Watch on YouTube opens externally regardless of external-player preference, requiring the TV app or mobile app/web fallback without guaranteeing availability.

home-navigation.summary: Screens & Navigation separates Home layout/hero, Rows, Filtering, main shortcuts and movie/show details. Presets replace custom Home arrangements after confirmation without editing servers; collection sections retain source identity, presentation choices and failure recovery. History feeds ignore library discovery switches, with no age/count cap for Continue Watching/merged Next Up and separate Next Up previews capped at 20. Recently Added and Hero & discovery filters are presentation-only with different defaults and candidate limits. Showcase and the carousel remain separate. Discovery recommendations do not require Seerr, but a new profile's carousel follows its connection until Discovery is explicitly toggled; Kids policy still excludes Discovery. All three TV navigation layouts offer eligible library shortcuts; changes retain saved order. Mobile starts with Home, Downloads and Search subject to availability; other destinations, including individual libraries and All Libraries, start Hidden until explicitly shown. Compact More contains overflow of shown destinations, not hidden shortcuts. TV sidebars retain Settings, Top Bar has a profile-picker escape, and mobile retains the profile-button route. Reset Navigation does not reset library tabs or access. Main layout/shortcuts stay local per profile/device; Home preferences transfer.

appearance.summary: Keep themes, density, focus, artwork and language distinctions in one guide. Customize labels selects Page; Home/Recommended have page Default plus row Overrides. Mixed hides captions on series artwork and in TV Showcase. Continue Watching's Use default inherits its context; On/Off applies to both Home and Recommended. Home Libraries has its own override; contextual editors share the same preference store and collection/playlist members use Browse. Watch indicators now explicitly distinguish unstarted flags, completed checks and Hidden, separately from episode counts, count style and Show progress bars. Hiding marks/bars neither changes history nor clears resume; these profile-owned settings are transfer-allowlisted. Retain Liquid Glass, independent header sizes, profile artwork versus shared metadata sources, saved download artwork, and interface language versus media language/device region.

spoilers.summary: Spoiler Protection remains in Screens & Navigation > All screens, with platform labels, blur/placeholder, in-progress image/text differences, chapter masking and independently hidden/revealable review scores. Home > Rows > Continue Watching owns Artwork + logo/Thumbnail/Poster, Playback details and Labels; only Thumbnail uses episode stills. Labels now uses Use default for contextual inheritance, with On/Off shared across Home/Recommended. Progress only removes playback text but bars still respect the profile's independent Show progress bars preference. Hidden rows retain settings and Add row recovery. Card selection defaults to Play or can open details; TV Play/Pause remains direct. Presentation changes neither watched state nor membership.

circadian.summary: Set solar-region, manual or always-on dimming, adjust warmth and fade, preview a day, disable the effect, and separate profile-owned app tint from system or TV settings.

playback.summary: Use remote/mobile controls, same-account versions, prompt/automatic selection and independent series memory. Ask to resume or start over is a separate opt-in control: before an in-progress video, Resume shows remaining time and Start Over the full runtime when known; resume rewind remains independent. The shared prompt is wired through the TV player host and mobile Home/details without dropping the pending request. Keep autoplay, Up Next, category/marker-specific skipping and community privacy/coverage limits. Chapters needs usable source/file chapters with optional images; zoom is session-only and cast-page navigation ends playback. External handoff stays in its focused guide with direct-source eligibility, token sharing, fallback and authorized progress-return limits.

quality.summary: Set profile-owned mobile network defaults or a Video > Quality session limit. Maximum removes the app's reduction limit, not server compatibility decisions; lower limits permit originals only with fitting known dimensions/bitrate, otherwise conversion can be required. Custom limits take a supported resolution and whole-number total Kbps; invalid saved limits must be replaced rather than treated as Maximum. HEVC preference can fall back to H.264 at the same limit. Playing in SDR identifies an SDR conversion; Current stream uses active facts, Declared stream bitrate is not throughput, and missing facts remain Not available. Preserve server permission/capacity, Silo resolution/codec limits, forced-conversion recovery and external-handoff exclusions. Device-local Video buffer applies on new sessions across all platforms, not quality/downloads, with space/native-path limits; Live TV buffer is a separate cushion, not recording.

audio.summary: Select tracks/language; series memory stores language, not an exact commentary track, codec or mix, and can follow matched series across servers. Playback > Audio exposes default-on Prefer lossless audio in both shells. Turning it off requests Plozzigen's compressed surround-compatible output, useful for regular HDMI ARC. The adapter samples it for on-demand/live loads, not native-engine or external-app playback; reopen video/retune after changes. Actual output depends on source/equipment. It is shared across Plozz profiles on this device and excluded from sync/transfer. Retain no adjustable engine audio delay, opt-in mobile Background Audio/data use, and output-gated TV Reduce Loud Sounds/Enhance Dialogue with system-wide scope and Settings recovery. Screens & Navigation > Movie & show details > Background > Theme music plays through the shared controller on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad. Theme music volume is 0%-100%; adjusting it can preview automatically and Play preview/Stop preview provide explicit control. Preview resolution checks authorized Home titles, then can use a generated sample if none supplies a theme; a preview is not universal title availability. Leaving the page stops the preview. Detail music fades in/out, pauses outside the app, and yields to trailers/full playback. The mobile detail speaker button toggles Mute theme music/Unmute theme music only during active detail playback; session mute changes neither saved volume nor Settings previews and resets on leaving that detail. Off selects static detail art independently of Home trailers and video tracks.

subtitles.summary: Select/search tracks, distinguish forced/SDH and per-content policies, enter mobile language codes or follow device language, style text or Live TV, and manage second tracks. Mobile Subtitles > Advanced… contains Second Track, Subtitle Delay and Appearance > Style; Search & Download… opens search separately. Portrait starts in Playback options. Prefer SDH permits fallback; Only SDH makes automatic/search/download choices strict without overriding manual or remembered choices. Matching device caption style replaces custom appearance after confirmation; edits exit matching while placement/dual controls remain Plozz-specific. Explain embedded Plozzigen versus fetchable native text, image-primary exclusion, secondary Off, timing and AirPlay limits. External apps receive eligible fetchable SRT sidecars without Plozz styling/dual guarantees; custom templates receive no subtitle links.

music.summary: Find Apple TV music from supported server libraries, start album/playlist sessions, use shuffle/repeat and the scrolling current-track card to reopen Now Playing, continue listening through the screensaver and use Control Center Now Playing transport controls. Trace background audio through the controller and shared system-command session. Explain synchronized lyrics and Last.fm eligibility without promising mobile music or downloads. LRCLIB requests can send title/artist/duration, not audio; MusicTabView gates future LRCLIB work on NowPlayingView's shared device toggle. While lyrics are enabled but unavailable, the toggle is disabled, so switch it off on a track with usable lyrics; switching back on triggers resolution. This is separate from profile-owned tracker authorization. AudioPlaybackController admits only nonempty synchronized lyrics, despite plain-text support in the model/view, so omit plain-lyrics instructions as unwired.

live-tv.summary: Set up IPTV or server channels and distinguish direct M3U catalogues from web pages, single-stream HLS and XMLTV. The main sign-in form exposes EPG URL (optional); Advanced options adds guides, playlist authentication and separate playlist/stream versus guide headers. Guide headers are scoped to the first guide URL's server, with empty fields following playlist credentials. Prefer HTTPS. Explain device-local account file imports separately from encrypted source-copy sync. Find on-demand libraries, correct guide mappings, favorite/hide channels and run per-playlist reachability checks. Review channel identities restores a saved channel only after same-station/feed confirmation; favorites, hidden state and guide corrections follow that identity, otherwise the separate entry remains playable. Channels/Programs search tunes live, not from programme start. Kids playlist-source PIN approvals grant the whole source locally, not ratings-based filtering or server-account authorization. Explain Multiview setup through Watch, four-pane/provider limits and one audible pane: focus selects sound on Apple TV, while mobile exposes Audio. Retain previews and original-file library-channel schedule/history limits; history is profile-scoped, device-local and default-off. Opted-in 90%-viewed completions use the normal watch-mutation pipeline without resume writes, including the cross-server setting and eligible connected trackers; this consequential cross-module workflow needs ongoing audit coverage. Mobile Settings > Live TV > Stop without Wi-Fi or Ethernet gates detected network changes, not every request; brief cellular use remains possible. Low Data Mode independently pauses Live TV even on Wi-Fi; use an unrestricted connection. Automatic-lineup Retry/Refresh is distinct from custom-channel editing. Live TV buffer is a local new-load cushion with latency/tuning costs, respected by Go Live, not a recording or a buffer for scheduled library files. A focused channel-organization guide explains category overrides, country-OR-language filtering, hidden-channel recovery and scanning. Guide retention only keeps listings supplied by the guide, not recordings. Connect as IPTV account migrates an existing simple playlist into the account catalogue without losing its source preferences; disable the older simple source afterward to avoid duplicate live entries.

offline.summary: Select the intended source/version on mobile details before downloading and test the validated, completed copy offline. Playback prefers a usable matching download even with another server/version selected; check the saved edition rather than assuming a source switch forces streaming. Manage Seasons downloads available episodes, not placeholders. Preparing/Downloading/Finishing are not completion; all bytes still need offline validation. Distinguish background HTTP from in-process/share work and fallible iOS 26 continued processing. Switching profiles pauses outgoing transfers; return to the owning profile to resume, subject to network policy. Retain quality/network policy, provider preparation, track limits, speed caps and uncapped background behavior. Reduced Jellyfin/Emby copies require Download Speed > Limit > Unlimited. Storage in Download Settings shows download use and available device capacity. Cancel Active Downloads deletes unfinished copies but keeps completed ones; Delete All Downloads removes this profile's saved videos, not server originals. Pause preserves work; notifications need permission. Completion notices open the title or batch without autoplay and require authorization for the owning profile rather than bypassing its lock.

profiles.summary: Separate app profiles/server users/Apple TV system users, mobile editing/switching, profile locks/Plex PIN reuse and automatic startup trust. With TV automatic sign-in off, background browsing returns to selection immediately if any profile is protected, otherwise after five minutes with multiple profiles; playback/handoff and inactive-only interruptions are exempt. Choose a Jellyfin/Emby sign-in or Plex Home user in Libraries through TV Watching as or mobile picker/identity rows. Plex identity also selects whose Watchlist is read and written. Explicitly choosing Don't use this server's watchlist excludes that contribution, not browsing/playback; disable and re-enable the server in Libraries to reconsider and choose a user. Do not equate every mobile sheet dismissal with an explicit decline. Add Another User/Add Another Plex Account authenticates an existing identity, adding shared device credentials rather than creating a server user. Confirm the identity/libraries and honor Plex PIN checks. Add your Plex Home profiles? offers Add all profiles or Just me on both platforms. Profiles added/Profiles ready advances automatically to Choose your profile after import; Just me opens Choose your Plex user with Back available. Bulk import creates or reuses profiles by existing Home-user binding, not a display-name match; only the selected viewer proceeds through authorization/setup. Other imported profiles remain awaiting setup, not unlocked or automatically Kids. Kids Profile and the household Parental PIN require separate configuration. Library discovery switches do not remove account-wide Continue Watching/Next Up or impose server maturity restrictions. A household PIN enforces Kids settings/switching and Seerr admin-request gates. Kids playlist sources stay blocked until a PIN exists and each source is approved on that device, independently of general Kids-restriction enforcement. Approvals are whole-source, local and identity-bound, not ratings filtering. No forgotten-PIN reset is wired; another device must already permit unlocked editing to remove a synced lock.

sync.summary: Distinguish CloudKit configuration, encrypted tracker tokens, mobile Keychain adoption, provider-limited nearby transfer and Silo approval. Apple TV fetches enabled cloud sync on foreground rather than relying on background delivery. Explain network/permission/code-verification requirements and separate cross-server history. Watchlist filters and sort order are transferable profile preferences, separately from membership; the allowlisted WatchlistBrowsePreferencesStore key travels with profile snapshots. Display Size, navigation style and main shortcut arrangement stay local per profile, as does Apple TV accidental-exit prevention, rather than syncing or transferring; library-tab order does transfer. Downloads/startup/Video buffer/Live TV buffer/Top Shelf remain local too. Prefer lossless audio stays local across Plozz profiles and is excluded from transfer because it depends on connected equipment. Diagnostics consent is neither synced nor transferred and is not profile-owned. External-player selection is device-wide and local; returned progress stays with the authorized original viewer/server. Live TV source copies sync encrypted per profile; account-imported M3U files and Kids approvals stay local, schedules need snapshots, and legacy source import differs from account import. Refresh Breakdown shows encoded local payload/count snapshots, not iCloud storage: include pending uploads/catalogue schedules; exclude pending deletions/downloaded IPTV guides and separate Keychain/Trakt records. On all three platforms iCloud Sync > Troubleshooting offers Reload From iCloud and destructive Reset Sync; distinguish downloading shared settings from replacing them with this device's copy. Retain erase/re-upload prevention and mobile Keychain erasure. Transferable presentation preferences grant neither access nor unsupported modes.

tracking.summary: Connect profile-owned video/anime/music trackers and check media/account/build eligibility. Distinguish outbound playback-to-history scrobbling from readable/writable Watchlists: Plozz does not import a tracker's complete watch history into media servers. Supported external returns can deliver unfinished Trakt pause progress through the durable watch outbox; finished returns keep normal history reporting. Mark as Unwatched does not delete Trakt history. WeTrakr is enabled by the production flag but still requires configured client credentials; its settings, both playback fan-outs and planning-list destination are wired. Document its authorization, Watchlist behavior, Retry/profile-wide Reconnect and failed-revocation recovery without promising the row in an unconfigured build.

requests.summary: Configure authorized Seerr and each profile's acting user; explain quotas, relinking and standard requests versus offline downloads or 4K requests. TMDB-matched library shows expose season request/status on Apple TV and Manage Seasons on mobile: request a season/All Missing, refresh status and handle failure/decline in Seerr. Requested · Unreleased indicates an approved request with a known future release and no reported download activity, not a promised download start; pending requests remain distinct. Kids/admin checks run in both shells/ProfileStore but unrestricted admin requests require a household Parental PIN to block them; also choose a restricted Seerr user. Release & Availability is independent of request status, playable ownership and paid-service entitlement.

metadata.summary: Explain shared metadata priorities/disablement, local TMDB credential verification, profile artwork choices and source/build-dependent review scores. Jellyfin details can prefer valid cached MDBList Ratings plugin scores in server-supplied order, without a new Plozz key/toggle or upstream refresh; absent/failed/invalid results retain ordinary enrichment. Home can reuse already-cached plugin ratings. Emby does not use this API. Show content ratings is a default-on profile setting under Screens & Navigation > All screens; turning it off hides classifications on Home/details/Top Shelf, not review scores or Common Sense guidance, and never enforces access restrictions. Common Sense detail requires viewing-account Plex Pass. Shares support matching video-stem NFO, show-root tvshow.nfo and named local artwork after rescan/metadata work, subject to unambiguous supported associations and artwork policy. Cache clearing affects lookup data/derived images, not downloads or server matching. External-title Release & Availability shows device-region releases and TMDB/JustWatch offers, independently of Seerr, playable ownership and subscriptions; missing offers do not prove unavailability.

help.summary: Keep symptom checks and reset/cache scopes non-destructive. Incomplete library results offer Details/Try Again, while Home row statuses offer Details/Retry without discarding saved choices; No streams found rechecks inventory, not playback. Restore saved sign-ins without deleting connections; Plex Home can require the original account, not a PIN reset. Cover Discord/GitHub/mobile email, duplicate checks and safe reproduction/device/source details. Startup diagnostics choices both continue; reporting defaults off and needs current consent plus a configured endpoint. Share Diagnostics is device-wide, not profile-owned or transferred. Send Diagnostics offers Enable Sharing when off; consenting enables reporting without submitting the manual report. Both platforms then use Message (required) and Send to Developer; blank messages disable Send and CrashDiagnostics rejects them. Automatic Sentry reports include fixed screen categories/performance evidence but exclude identity/server/media/history. Explicit submissions include allowlisted activity, search, connection, preparation, failed-library-load and retained playback/source evidence, not free-form Recent Activity messages. Search evidence excludes query text, names and URLs. The submitted message is sent as written, so exclude secrets and personal details. Export aliases are scoped to one submission. Mobile Refresh/filter/search/Copy exports an activity summary without message text, whereas local display, manual text selection and screenshots can expose server/content details. Submitted confirms SDK handoff, not receipt or a public issue. Privacy Policy is reachable in consent/Settings, with a TV QR handoff. Apple TV Home Performance Overlay is wired through MainTabView/HomeView and exposes FPS, hitches and thermal state for stutter reports; the mobile toggle has no Home renderer consumer, so do not promise a mobile overlay. Local error details need no upload consent. Settings > Release Notes remains reachable after startup notices are disabled. Show release notes on startup for new versions and the confirmed Don’t Show Again action control automatic notices, not manual access.

platforms.summary: Explain remote/touch/keyboard, VoiceOver, optional gestures, iPhone full-window orientation versus iPad system rotation, and TV fades that do not enable system matching. Mobile pinch switches Normal/Crop; the playback task explains session-only zoom modes. Link Apple TV's automatic-sign-in and background-browsing return checks, distinct from playback departures and brief inactive interruptions. Top Shelf offers shared local adult controls, Posters/Full Screen and 1-20 counts defaulting four; source-scoped snapshots retain authorization/spoiler limits. Trace Guide OS entry and music Now Playing commands. Distinguish live seeking/Go Live from library-channel Jump to now and recording. Live TV buffer applies on new live stream loads, not library files, and Go Live retains its latency/tuning tradeoffs. Conversion diagnostics separate active video/audio facts from original-source details; neither establishes physical speaker layout. Throughput is not encoded bitrate and temporary cache is not downloads. Retain remuxed AirPlay subtitle loss, Multiview/PiP limits and authorized external-player returns.

FeatureAuth.summary: Keep provider sign-in and verified alternate addresses in the server task. Saved-account Sign In Again is wired in both shells for Jellyfin/Plex/Emby/Silo, validates the original account/server/profile and replaces credentials without deleting the saved connection; cancellation/failure preserves it. Network retry and IPTV/share connection editing remain separate. Plex Home recovery reauthenticates the original Plex account before the intended user's normal access/PIN checks, not a PIN reset.

FeatureDiscovery.summary: Use LAN discovery or manual entry; Jellyfin/Emby public checks prefer HTTPS, try eligible HTTP alternatives before authentication and stop rather than downgrade after explicit HTTPS or TLS trust rejection. The same resolver is wired through the shared picker model into mobile AddServerView. Saved routes keep exact-address behavior. Tailscale is an externally configured connection requiring the server's IP/MagicDNS address, not a Plozz-managed VPN or discoverable LAN server.

FeatureHome.summary: Keep browsing, collection recovery, source/version selection, Watchlists and schedule-only placeholders together. Both shells now resolve All Libraries through FeatureHomeCore's shared source inventory/merge policy; mobile has a reachable navigation destination but still no alphabet rail. Name-sort rail behavior is TV-only; unused menu/observed feedback state is not a mobile jump control. Library presentation, collection covers and Home rows retain independent scopes and failure recovery. Account-wide history ignores disabled-library discovery. Both shells wire detail theme music and server trailers with lifecycle/authorization checks; online trailers open YouTube externally with mobile-only web fallback. The TV Home performance overlay supports stutter reporting, not a mobile overlay. Rendering/skeleton changes do not create new reader procedures.

FeatureLiveTV.summary: Cover reachable channel menus, previews, Multiviews, guide search/correction, source-scoped channel-identity review, local Kids playlist approvals and channel checks. The mobile destination wires the network policy into playback eligibility: Wi-Fi-only enforcement follows detected changes, while Low Data Mode independently pauses live playback until an unrestricted connection is available. Automatic library channels offer preparation Retry and ready-state Refresh, but no individual editing; custom channels retain their separate editor. Guide options reaches Review channel identities; confirmed historical identity is applied by the durable cache/import model and reuses saved preferences only when the old entry is absent. The playlist detail's SettingsPageLink reaches scanning; its global Sources destination is nested under library-channel management and unreliable. Source-copy import exists for legacy/fallback flows and syncs differently from current IPTV-account file imports; do not invent a universal alternate import procedure. Personal channel-label/preferences and the separate unavailable-favorite recovery helper have no prototype presentation route, so omit them as unusable controls without confusing them with the reachable identity review. Maintain the focused channel-organization sections, guide retention limits and source-to-IPTV-account migration; these are reachable workflows, unlike the retired personal channel editor.

FeatureMusic.summary: Cover Apple TV server-library listening, queue controls, lyrics and Last.fm, including screensaver/background listening and Control Center transport. Explain LRCLIB title/artist/duration queries and the shared device-wide lyrics toggle that gates future lookups, including its enabled-but-no-lyrics disabled state. This privacy/scope workflow predates the current source delta and needs ongoing full-audit coverage; it is not tracker scrobbling or a new standalone page.

FeaturePlayback.summary: Use task sections for player preferences, text/image/dual-subtitle limits, confirmed caption-style replacement and live rewind. Mobile menus consolidate in portrait and separate in landscape; Advanced… owns second subtitles, delay and style, while Video owns Quality/zoom. Session-only Normal/Crop/Stretch/Custom zoom has an explained 50%-200% range. Chapters needs usable provider/file chapters; seeking preserves play/pause intent and episode spoilers, and thumbnails are optional. Series audio memory stores language, not an exact mix. Prefer lossless audio selects the Plozzigen adapter's lossless/surroundCompat request at each video/live load; neither the native engine nor an external app consumes this device preference, and requested mode does not guarantee actual output. Live TV buffer is a new-load cushion with latency/tuning costs, separate from library files. Neither wired engine advertises audio-delay or engine-local dialogue processing; the TV system bridge separately exposes output-gated global Reduce Loud Sounds/Enhance Dialogue and recovery. Cast page navigation ends playback. Diagnostics separate active conversion facts, original sources, measured throughput, player-window/buffer values and temporary cache without claiming physical speaker layout. PlayerScreenshotHook and LiveChannelScreenshotHook only preselect panels for internal capture; they expose no reader screenshot workflow.

FeatureProfiles.summary: Cover profile setup, entry/edit authorization, Kids restrictions and device-local automatic sign-in. Apple TV's separate browsing-return policy is wired through foreground protection, profile flow and RootView: automatic sign-in off permits immediate protected-profile checks or a five-minute unprotected multi-profile timeout, excluding playback departures and inactive-only interruptions. Plex Home onboarding offers bulk import or Just me without authenticating other imported users; the brief import confirmation advances automatically to Choose your profile, while Just me opens Choose your Plex user. New profiles carry isAwaitingSetup and their own Home-user binding, not automatically a Kids flag. The selected viewer must still complete authorization and setup. The Forgot PIN strings in ProfileLockCopy have no presentation call site; both the shared entry PIN screen and management actions lack a reset control. Do not promise recovery from unused labels; another device must already have unlocked editing access before removing a synced lock.

FeatureSearch.summary: Global search retains its library task; consent-scoped provider categories, counts, timing and request failures also support manual diagnostic reports without storing query text, content names, URLs or provider identifiers. This is diagnostic evidence, not uploaded search history or a promise to retain search sessions across restarts.

FeatureSettings.summary: Group by task and platform/provider applicability, not by toggle. Preserve Home Rows/Add row, separate watched-content Filtering, current Home/Libraries/Movie & show details paths and TV navigation layouts/shortcut recovery. Keep shared Card labels, independent Logo/Text sizing, spoilers and classification controls distinct from restrictions. Collection-cover shapes have independent library/Recommended/Home scopes and do not style titles within collections. Detail music works in both shells; audio explains volume, preview/generated fallback and mobile session mute. Prefer lossless audio has an output-compatibility section, retaining default, device scope, adapter wiring, new-load timing and hardware limits. Profiles covers TV/mobile server users and adding shared sign-ins without creating users. Skipping, independent buffers, saved-sign-in recovery and sync-data sizes stay in their tasks. Feedback explains Share Diagnostics, Enable Sharing without submission, Message (required), Send to Developer and Submitted's SDK-handoff limit, plus privacy and TV Home stutter measurements. Reload/reset are reachable in both sync troubleshooting UIs. External-player choice retains its focused guide for device scope, eligibility, token sharing and returned progress. Low-risk sort/recently-watched controls need no new pages. Developer Mode and Reset to First Run are hidden diagnostic/setup-retest surfaces gated by DeveloperModeModel in both settings shells, not routine recovery procedures; omit their unlock/reset steps rather than recommending destructive setup erasure.

FeatureSyncCloud.summary: Separate settings/profile/media/tracker channels from mobile Keychain adoption. Profile snapshots explicitly include Watchlist filter/sort preferences, independently of saved-title membership. Profile preference capture excludes device-specific density, main navigation and exit/zoom settings; their per-profile stores do not make them transferable. Prefer lossless audio likewise stays local but is shared across profiles on the device. Live TV source secrets/imported source chunks are encrypted; sync cannot grant local parental approval or materialize an account-imported M3U on another device. Explain on-demand local payload/count snapshots and their exclusions without representing them as CloudKit storage usage. Keep destructive reset/erase warnings and schedule catalogue requirements.

FeatureSyncSetup.summary: Explain reachable receiver/sender setup, local network and scan permissions, code/QR alternatives, conditional verification and provider transfer limits. Same-account rendezvous and scanned QR pin the recipient key; ordinary links do not silently bypass verification.

FeatureWatchlist.summary: The focused Watchlist guide covers saving, removal, navigation, filtering and sorting on Apple TV/iPhone/iPad. Shared UI exposes All/Movies/TV Shows, Clear Filters, Date Added/Release Date/Name and Order. Save dates are distinct from library import; undated entries follow dated entries. The profile-scoped browse model and transfer allowlist preserve those choices, independently of Home row order. Document explicit saves plus enabled-destination contributions, minus explicit removals. Jellyfin/Emby contribute Favorites; Plex and Silo contribute Watchlists. Disabling a server retracts native contributions without erasing explicit saves. Plex user selection determines native identity; decline excludes that list without disabling browsing/playback, and disabling/re-enabling clears the decline for another choice. Confirmed native-list removals after acknowledged additions can propagate; genuine re-adds can supersede removal. Failed reads/deliveries are not confirmed deletions and are retried. Pending Removing and optimistic local confirmation are not proof that every remote destination accepted the change. Native timestamps, release-date payloads and ownership enrichment support this workflow, not another settings page.

MediaDownloads.summary: Explain network/speed limits, provider copies and offline validation: Finishing/all bytes received is not completion. The registry/resolver tries compatible same-title copies with the requested version first, retaining another usable download when the preferred copy is incomplete or missing. Mobile version preparation and shared player routing prioritize that local asset over streaming, even when a different server/version was selected. Background HTTP differs from in-process share work; continued processing/Live Activities remain an OS decision. Profile transitions quiesce outgoing transfers and returning can resume them under normal network policy. Storage shows download use and available capacity. Movie/episode menus act on one copy; show menus pause/resume the group or remove its downloaded episodes after confirmation. Distinguish those from destructive bulk cancellation of unfinished copies and profile-scoped deletion of all saved downloads.

MediaTransportFTP.summary: Cover FTP and manually addressed implicit FTPS in the share task; composition does not produce explicit AUTH TLS connections.

MediaTransportHTTP.omitReason: Shared HTTP sessions and trust/range plumbing are not a separately selectable library type in the add-share UI. MediaTransportNFS.summary: State the wired NFSv3 requirement and export-based access rules in the network-share procedure, not a separate protocol guide.

MediaTransportWebDAV.summary: A wired share transport, not a media server. Successful listings can lack the validators required for playback. Network shares explains valid bounded HTTP responses, strong ETag or valid Last-Modified, administrator/proxy checks and rescan/reopen after file replacement. Source identity changes fail closed rather than silently continuing another representation.

MetadataKit.summary: Keep provider ordering/cache controls in metadata, lyric availability and LRCLIB title/artist/duration sharing in music, and community skips in playback. The music area traces the device-wide toggle into the lyric resolver's online-query gate. Home explains selecting public Discovery catalogues independently of Seerr requests, with Kids restrictions and no implied playable ownership. This is recommendation discovery, not the FeatureDiscovery module's LAN server search. Marker requests include applicable title/episode metadata and runtime, not video uploads; server markers and third-party coverage remain distinct. Regional releases/watch offers are populated only for external/discovery details and rendered independently of Seerr; explain them beside title requests without requiring a request connection. TMDB's authorized videos API can supply trailer links after server-owned files and server metadata are considered; it does not verify YouTube availability. Explain the reachable external handoff in library, not a nonexistent streaming-trailer provider or scraping workflow.

ProviderIPTV.summary: Keep playlist/Xtream and EPG setup, scoped guide credentials, local account-file imports, guide-only operation and optional on-demand catalogues in existing source/library tasks. HTTP/proxy/parsing diagnostics do not add a new selectable source type.

ProviderJellyfin.summary: Keep provider sign-in, library and music behavior in their tasks. The optional Jellyfin-only server-ratings seam reads same-origin authenticated MDBList Ratings CachedByItemId data without fetching upstream services or running plugin refresh/scripts. Detail enrichment prefers valid nonempty results with fallback on absence/failure; Home consumes already-cached results. No new Plozz token or switch is required, and this API must not be inferred for Emby.

ProviderShare.summary: Cover share connection/scanning and movie/TV local NFO/artwork association in existing guides. Personal Videos deliberately bypasses catalogue matching. Local metadata precedence and ambiguous-folder rejection are implemented in scanner/enrichment/projection, not inferred from NFO filenames alone.

TopShelfKit.summary: Document Apple TV placement, local shared visibility/layout/count preferences, same-copy deduplication, Play versus More Info and current access checks. Full-screen metadata uses known source facts, series artwork and spoiler policy, never a guarantee of output or a live server browser. Poster/backdrop composition is infrastructure, not another reader control.

TraktService.summary: Separate Watchlist sync, completed watches and partial pause progress returned by supported external players. Mark as Unwatched does not delete Trakt history. Shared sign-in recovery belongs in trackers; receipt/debug response plumbing needs no separate user procedure.

WetrakrService.summary: Production-enabled but configuration-gated video tracking and planning-list read/write integration is reachable on both platforms. Cover authorization and connection recovery in trackers and list propagation in library. View on WeTrakr, when present for imported entries, is an external link/TV QR handoff rather than media playback; this self-explanatory link needs no standalone guide.

appearance.summary: Keep theme/cards/artwork together and Circadian scheduling in its focused task. Labels presets replace custom page defaults/row overrides; contextual editors share those preferences. Watch marks, episode counts and progress bars have independent controls without changing history. Spoiler Protection remains in Screens & Navigation > All screens, not Appearance.

language.summary: Use the appearance guide to explain System language selection and distinguish interface language from audio, subtitles, server-supplied metadata and device-region date/number formatting rather than a separate picker guide. System-drawn player controls and permission prompts keep the device language.

libraries.summary: Explain shared sign-ins versus profile-selected accounts/server users and library discovery switches. Choose a server user covers TV Watching as, mobile picker/Plex identity rows, PIN checks and Add Another User/Add Another Plex Account. Added logins are shared by profiles on this device; no server user is created. Disabled libraries hide browsing/discovery, not account-wide Continue Watching/Next Up, and are not permission or maturity filters. Showing a navigation shortcut is a separate task: mobile libraries start hidden, and All Libraries combines at least two enabled browsable non-music libraries on all three platforms. Keep music eligibility in its platform-specific task.

liveTV.summary: Keep guide previews, favorites/hidden channels, search and mobile cellular policy in the Live TV reference. Distinguish the Wi-Fi-only setting's detected-transition limit from the independent Low Data Mode pause, which also applies on Wi-Fi. Explain local whole-source Kids approval and source-configuration sync separately; straightforward ordering/filter choices need no individual pages.

playback.summary: Cover version mode/series memory, autoplay/skips, quality, audio, background listening, orientation/gestures and history with platform/provider gates. Explain the optional Ask to resume or start over prompt independently of resume rewind and version selection. Skip settings distinguish enablement, content categories, button/automatic delay and per-marker Off; community requests remain separately controllable. Remember audio language per series stores language, not exact commentary/mix. Default-on Prefer lossless audio is shared on this device, not synced/transferred; turning it off requests compressed surround-compatible Plozzigen output for newly loaded video/live streams, not a guaranteed hardware format or a native/external-player setting. Video buffer is temporary read-ahead, while independent local Live TV buffer requests a live-edge cushion; both are new-load choices, not offline downloads. Missing remembered versions fall back automatically in automatic mode. Advanced > External player is device-wide rather than profile-owned; its focused guide explains platform apps, custom templates, direct-play fallback, access-token sharing and authorized progress returns.

screensNavigation.summary: Screens & Navigation uses Home, Libraries and Movie & show details. Home separates TV Layout/mobile Hero, Rows and Filtering; preserve presets, source-qualified collections, default-on Next Up merging and saved-row recovery. Recently Added hides completed titles only when enabled; Hero & discovery hides watched suggestions by default. These independent filters change suggestions, not history/access/Continue Watching. App navigation owns Pinned Sidebar/Sidebar/Top Bar, delayed style application, library shortcuts, explicit Show and Settings recovery; layout/shortcuts stay local. Libraries edits supported profile tabs, Recommended rows and collection covers, not Home/shortcuts. Collection-only directories omit Recommended editing; library/Recommended/Home cover controls are independent and do not style member titles. Logo/Text sizing and contextual labels belong with appearance. All screens owns spoilers/classification display, not scores/restrictions. Movie & show details > Background offers mutually exclusive Trailer/Theme music/Off on all platforms, independently of Home trailers; audio explains volume, preview/generated fallback and mobile session mute. DetailNavigationTransition is internal animation plumbing, not a user-facing settings workflow; the retired transition key in ProfileSettingsSnapshot does not establish an available control.

subtitles.summary: Combine language codes/device fallback, per-content policies, SDH/search, remembered series choices and text/image styling limits rather than separate pages per preference. Explain Prefer SDH fallback versus strict Only SDH automatic/search/download selection, matching device caption appearance, replacement confirmation and leaving matching through custom edits.

Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSStreamingQua.navigation: Open mobile Settings > Playback > Streaming quality, or a supported player quality menu.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSStreamingQua.experience: Set separate local, remote-network, and cellular limits, edit custom quality, or deliberately force conversion.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSStreamingQua.conditions: iPhone/iPad. Quality conversion needs provider/server support; network classification and current playback path affect the available choices. It is not download quality.

Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSSyncSetupRec.navigation: Choose Set Up from Another Device in mobile onboarding or Set Up From Another Device in configured Sync settings.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSSyncSetupRec.experience: Advertise this receiving device and display its QR/short code; wait for the configured device to send setup, then review the received accounts and profiles.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSSyncSetupRec.conditions: iPhone/iPad on the local network. This receiver displays codes rather than opening the sender scanner. Approve comparison codes only when they match; verified same-account pairing can authenticate without a comparison.

Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSSyncSetupSen.navigation: On the configured iPhone/iPad, open Settings > iCloud Sync, then Scan QR Code or Enter Code under Set Up Another Device.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSSyncSetupSen.experience: Scan the receiving device QR code or type its short code; review the successful transfer summary after authorization.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSSyncSetupSen.conditions: iPhone/iPad sender helper screens. Scanning requires Camera permission; code entry does not. Both devices need local-network access. Compare matching codes if prompted; same-account verification can omit that step.

Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSSyncSetupSet.navigation: From an adult mobile profile, open Settings > iCloud Sync.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSSyncSetupSet.experience: Inspect shared sync, copy setup to/from another device, sign in pending accounts, or use explicit recovery actions.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSSyncSetupSet.conditions: iPhone/iPad. iCloud account/entitlements and profile permissions gate availability; Silo remains per-device. Reload, Reset and Erase have different destructive effects.

Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSTrackerSetti.navigation: Open mobile Settings > Trackers, then choose a supported tracker.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSTrackerSetti.experience: Authorize the service in a browser, inspect the linked identity, or disconnect it.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSTrackerSetti.conditions: iPhone/iPad. Each tracker has its own authorization/configuration and compatible content. Last.fm connection UI is Apple TV-only.

Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSUnifiedAddSh.navigation: On iPhone/iPad, choose Add Network Share during setup or from server settings.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSUnifiedAddSh.experience: Choose a transport, verify trusted endpoints, browse a folder/export, and create its library.
Sources/AppShelliOS/PlozziOSUnifiedAddSh.conditions: iPhone/iPad. Local Network permission is needed for local discovery. Transport-specific credentials, certificate approval, host keys, and content choices appear only for the selected method. The protocol picker order is SMB, NFS, WebDAV, SFTP, FTP; FTPS uses an ftps address under FTP rather than a separate protocol choice.
